description: Animal cruelty law penalizes unnecessary suffering of protected animals including deliberate physical mistreatment of dogs, and establishes animal welfare offences.
Independent criminal conviction review agency investigates potential wrongful convictions caused by unreliable computer forensic evidence and flawed prosecution records and refers cases for appeal.

Data protection safeguards restrict solely automated administrative decisions involving profiling of welfare benefits applicants, allowing affected people to contest such decisions and request human intervention.
AI Act high-risk automated welfare benefits decision system duties include technical risk management and governance for public eligibility determinations, with later staged application.
Industrial air emissions and wastewater monitoring requires environmental permits and pollutant reporting for manufacturing sites.
Traffic safety and road transport statutes regulate licensing vehicles, seat belts and driving on public roads.
Education authorities may consider school attendance and educational intervention for young people through separate welfare and youth institutions.
Property tax assessment and local land valuation disputes may be appealed to independent valuation tribunals.
Public health response plans regulate infectious disease surveillance, isolation and access to preventive healthcare.
